candidates.researchQuestion: How should a durable agent runtime represent one human decision for one concrete tool-call occurrence when a broader sticky authorization default already exists?
candidates.title: Durable Agent Approval Needs an Occurrence Boundary
candidates.title_zh: 持久化 Agent 授权需要动作实例边界

sections.heading: A durable decision needs a narrow object
sections.heading_zh: 持久决定需要窄范围授权对象

sections.heading: Separate the decision from the actor and the effect
sections.heading_zh: 把决定、主体与外部效果分开

sections.heading: What this mechanism does not establish
sections.heading_zh: 这个机制没有建立什么

sections.heading: Open questions for high-risk resumable actions
sections.heading_zh: 高风险恢复动作仍待回答的问题

evidenceClaims.claim: OpenAI Agents Python RunState schema 1.16 resolves exact approved or rejected call IDs before sticky defaults, allowing one concrete call to override a broader tool-level decision without changing sibling calls.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: OpenAI Agents Python RunState Schema 1.16 会先解析精确 Approved/Rejected Call ID，再回退到 Sticky Default，因此单个具体 Call 可以覆盖更宽的 Tool-level 决定而不改变其他调用。

evidenceClaims.claim: Reversing an exact decision removes the same call ID from the opposite exact-decision list, and serialization/resume tests preserve the exact exception together with the sticky default.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 反转精确决定时会从相反的 Exact-decision List 移除同一 Call ID；序列化与 Resume 测试保留 Exact Exception 与 Sticky Default。

evidenceClaims.claim: The selected mechanism does not authenticate the approver, make call IDs cryptographically unforgeable or establish exactly-once external effects.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所选机制不会认证 Approver 身份，不会使 Call ID 具备密码学不可伪造性，也不会建立外部 Exactly-once Effect。

evidenceClaims.claim: Durable authorization is clearer when default policy, occurrence-scoped exception, actor/authority evidence and external-effect evidence remain separate state layers.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 当 Default Policy、Occurrence-scoped Exception、Actor/Authority Evidence 与 External-effect Evidence 保持为不同状态层时，持久化 Authorization 更清晰。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion is general to durable agent and digital-employee authorization; no first-party project is required.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already addresses the transferable engineering question.

candidates.researchQuestion: How can an orchestration system let a host attach state before an execution object fully materializes without confusing reserved identity, object existence and metadata authority?
candidates.title: Reserved Identity Is Not Materialized State
candidates.title_zh: 预留身份不等于对象已经物化

sections.heading: Reservation, intent, and existence are different states
sections.heading_zh: Reservation、Intent 与 Existence 是不同状态

sections.heading: Merge and cleanup need explicit ownership
sections.heading_zh: Merge 与 Cleanup 都需要明确 Ownership

evidenceClaims.claim: Codex can reserve the final ThreadId before startup for new, cleared or forked creation and rejects a reserved ID for resume of an existing thread.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Codex 可在启动前预留最终 ThreadId 用于 New、Cleared 或 Forked 创建，并拒绝用 Reserved ID Resume 已存在 Thread。

evidenceClaims.claim: Host-owned metadata is staged in a pending registry keyed by the reserved ID, merged into the first successful metadata update and then consumed; unmaterialized shutdown or discard can clear it.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Host-owned Metadata 按 Reserved ID 暂存在 Pending Registry 中，在第一次成功 Metadata Update 时合并并随后消费；未 Materialize 的 Shutdown 或 Discard 可清理它。

evidenceClaims.claim: The mechanism limits staging and preserves pending state conservatively when rollout existence is uncertain.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 该机制限制可暂存字段，并在 Rollout Existence 不确定时保守保留 Pending State。

evidenceClaims.claim: Pre-materialization orchestration is clearer when identity reservation, bounded host intent, authoritative materialization and cleanup are explicit lifecycle phases.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 当 Identity Reservation、有限 Host Intent、Authoritative Materialization 与 Cleanup 成为显式生命周期阶段时，Pre-materialization Orchestration 更清晰。

projectRelevance.rationale: The lifecycle distinction is general to orchestration architecture and requires no first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: No separate community framing adds enough value beyond the complete Research Center analysis.

candidates.researchQuestion: How should an SDK expose a raw configuration escape hatch for values its structured serializer cannot represent while keeping effective configuration understandable and preventing accidental ownership inversion?
candidates.title: Configuration Precedence Needs Provenance
candidates.title_zh: 配置优先级还需要来源追踪

sections.heading: Deterministic order solves conflict, not meaning
sections.heading_zh: 确定顺序解决冲突，但不解释含义

sections.heading: Provenance is the missing half of configuration governance
sections.heading_zh: Provenance 是配置治理缺失的另一半

evidenceClaims.claim: CodexOptions adds ordered raw configOverrides that are forwarded unchanged after structured configuration and preserve caller order, including duplicate keys.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: CodexOptions 新增有序 Raw configOverrides，在 Structured Configuration 之后原样转发，并保留调用方顺序，包括 Duplicate Key。

evidenceClaims.claim: SDK-managed and thread/run-specific settings are emitted after raw overrides, yielding the observed precedence structured global configuration < ordered raw overrides < SDK-managed settings < thread/run-specific settings.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: SDK-managed 与 Thread/Run-specific Setting 在 Raw Override 之后输出，形成观察到的 Structured Global < Ordered Raw < SDK-managed < Thread/Run-specific 优先级。

evidenceClaims.claim: The raw channel preserves literal TOML structures, but the SDK does not validate the security meaning of arbitrary raw values and deterministic ordering is not a security guarantee.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Raw Channel 保留 Literal TOML Structure，但 SDK 不验证任意 Raw Value 的安全含义，Deterministic Ordering 也不是安全保证。

evidenceClaims.claim: Multi-layer configuration needs provenance in addition to precedence so security-relevant effective values can be traced to their source layer and ownership boundary.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 多层配置除 Precedence 外还需要 Provenance，使安全相关 Effective Value 可追溯到 Source Layer 与 Ownership Boundary。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general SDK and CLI configuration architecture; no first-party project is required.

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center edition already contains the necessary mechanism, evidence boundaries and engineering implications.
